question: Select the correctly spelt word meaning 'a person who lives a self-denying life for spiritual discipline'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Ascetic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Ascetic"** means a person who lives a life of self-denial or abstinence, especially for spiritual discipline. (संयासी)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The monk lived an ascetic life, dedicating himself to prayer and meditation.
 
 
 
• It is derived from the Greek word *askētikos*, meaning "to exercise
